id./param/scenario/cs/a_070_cs_140.pack|cs_: "Ha ha ha ha!! What, even the desert killer is nothing special!!
"You all understand? You'll report that this was my achievement.
"Thanks to you, this should work out. Truly, thank you.
"This time I'll speak to Father about the Rainbough, so rest assured.
"Are you sure about this? Even if you win honor this way, I don't think anything will change.
"I don't like doing this either! To avoid betraying Father's and the people's expectations, this is all I can do!
"...I see. So that's how you'll live.
"Don't know if that was right. As you said, that wimp prince won't change like this.
"But he isn't satisfied with himself now. With the right spark, he might transform...
"I'll be off soon. If you see me on your travels, at least say hello. Adieu!
id./param/scenario/cs/a_070_cs_150.pack|cs_: "Behold! Our prince Faris has captured the desert killer!
"As long as we have a brave prince, Gallopolis's future is safe! Now, Faris! Say a word to the people!
"By turning your cheers into strength, I was able to defeat and capture the desert killer.
"In the future too, as this country's prince, I will strive harder...
"Everyone, don't panic! We have the prince! The prince will surely defeat the monster!
"O-oh! True! With Prince Faris we're safe!
"Prince!! Prince!! Prince!! Prince!!
"What is it, Faris? With your ability, it's no problem. Answer the people's expectations.
"Father... I can't do it...
"A knight must...!
"...Never bend his beliefs, and be loyal to his land. ...Huh?
"A knight must...!
"Face any adversity fairly and squarely!
"That's right! You're the prince of the Kingdom of Knights! If you don't want to end up a coward, fight!
"The prince of the Kingdom of Knights...!
"See, you can do it. You were cool.
"Y-you are...
"Listen, you're the prince of the Kingdom of Knights, so never forget chivalry, whatever happens.
"W-wait! You seem to understand chivalry deeply. Who are you?!
"Just a humble traveling entertainer.
id./param/scenario/cs/a_070_cs_160.pack|cs_: "...Father, Mother. And so it was {var:1} who ran the race and captured the monster.
"...Raise your head, Faris. It seems we never saw the real you and put unbearable pressure on you.
"Perhaps it is we who should apologize. From now on, your mother and I will change our thinking.
"Your courage in that fight was impressive. Defending alone, it was still worthy of a prince.
"With that courage, you'll one day join the unit of Heliodor's fierce general Hendrik, your goal. Ha ha ha!
"By the way, Father, I have a request. {var:1} and his companions here are traveling in search of the Rainbough.
"May I give the national treasure, the Rainbough, to {var:1} and the others who helped me?
"Hmm. That's impossible. I sold it to a peddler.
"You sold the Rainbough?! That's a national treasure! Why did you sell it?!
"Fool!! Why do you think this year's Faris Cup could be so lavish?!! I did it all for you!!
"Sorry about that, traveler. The peddler who bought the Rainbough said he was heading to Gondolia, west of here.
"Take this and you can pass the west checkpoint. Gather information in Gondolia.
"I'm sorry!! I truly didn't know about the Rainbough!! Please forgive me!!
"You've helped me so much. If you're ever in trouble, come back to Gallopolis!
"I will always lend you my strength!
id./param/scenario/cs/a_070_cs_170.pack|cs_: "I've been waiting, {var:1}!
"Gah! What are you doing here?! You still have business with us?
"Isn't it obvious? I'm coming along on your journey to Yggdrasil! And we'll defeat the evil god!
"No way! Where did you come from, saying that?! Our journey isn't a game!
"Of course I'm not coming for fun.
"As an entertainer I've traveled the world and met so many smiles...
"But just as many times, I've met the sorrow of people tormented by monsters...
"My dream is to build the world's biggest hall and put on a grand show to make people everywhere laugh.
"But if an evil god tries to steal everyone's smiles, that dream can't come true, can it?
"...So your journey's goal is my journey's goal too! Everyone, take care of me from now on!
Sylvando joined the party!
"Geez. Pushy as ever.
"So, what will you all do now?
"The Rainbough, key to Yggdrasil... I thought we'd go to Gondolia, chasing the merchant who got it.
"I see. But that's a port town. He might already be out at sea. How will you chase him then?
"True... In that case we'd have to transfer between regular ships...
"No, no. Regular ships take far too long. You'd never catch up.
"Then what are we supposed to do?
"Hee hee. Go by ship, of course. One we can use freely.
"That's right! The ship I own!
"Sylvando, that's wonderful! I knew you were no ordinary person!
"May we borrow your ship?!
"Of course! We're friends! Then let's go to Gondolia, where my ship is docked!
"Gondolia is west of here! Now, let's set off!
